author: life.with.akshat_
caption:
Comment "SOUND" to get 3 free tools that give your Claude video edits real sound effects.

Why do your Claude edits look pro but sound like a silent movie? Claude can't hear, so it fakes the sound.

1. Openverse: think of it like a free stock library of over 5 million openly licensed sounds, searchable through a free API with no key.
2. Real SFX: a free Claude Code skill that finds every moment in your video and puts a real recording on the exact frame. It even reads HyperFrames compositions.
3. earshot: open source (MIT), 2,877 GitHub stars in 11 days. It gives Claude ears: it scores your edit against 7 pro launch films and makes its own whooshes in code.

The honest part: Real SFX only ships 78 UI sounds, so it needs a library for whooshes and hits. That's why Openverse comes first. Check each sound's licence before you use it.

Send this to the friend making launch videos with Claude.
